seller_obligations: Make goods available at seller's premises. Provide commercial invoice and packing list.
buyer_obligations: Arrange all transport, export/import clearance, insurance, and bear all costs and risks from seller's premises.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are placed at the disposal of the buyer at the seller's premises or named place.
cost_transfer_point: All costs transfer to buyer once goods are made available at seller's premises.
key_notes: Minimum obligation for seller. Not recommended for international trade due to export clearance complexity for buyer. Suitable for domestic trade.

seller_obligations: Deliver goods to carrier or named place. Clear goods for export. Provide transport document.
buyer_obligations: Arrange main carriage, import clearance, and insurance. Bear all costs from delivery point.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers when goods are delivered to the carrier at the named place. If delivery at seller's premises, risk passes when loaded. If elsewhere, risk passes when goods are at disposal of carrier.
cost_transfer_point: Costs transfer at delivery to carrier at named place.
key_notes: 2020 update: buyer can instruct carrier to issue an on-board bill of lading to seller after loading. Most versatile rule.

seller_obligations: Deliver goods to carrier, arrange and pay for carriage to named destination. Clear goods for export.
buyer_obligations: Bear all risks from point of delivery (first carrier). Import clearance. Unloading costs at destination.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are handed over to the first carrier at the place of shipment — NOT at the named destination.
cost_transfer_point: Seller pays freight to named destination, but risk already transferred at first carrier.
insurance: No obligation on either party (but seller bears risk only to first carrier).
key_notes: Critical distinction: risk and cost transfer at DIFFERENT points. Risk transfers at origin, cost obligation extends to destination.

seller_obligations: Deliver goods to carrier, arrange and pay carriage to destination, AND procure insurance. Clear goods for export.
buyer_obligations: Bear all risks from first carrier. Import clearance. Unloading costs at destination.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are handed over to the first carrier — NOT at destination.
cost_transfer_point: Seller pays freight and insurance to destination, but risk transfers at first carrier.
insurance: Seller must obtain insurance with ALL-RISK coverage — Institute Cargo Clauses (A). This is a 2020 change from previous Clause (C).
key_notes: 2020 KEY UPDATE: CIP now mandates Institute Cargo Clauses (A) — maximum/all-risk coverage, unlike CIF which still uses Clause (C) minimum coverage.

seller_obligations: Deliver goods to named destination, ready for unloading. Arrange all transport. Clear for export. Bear all risks and costs to destination.
buyer_obligations: Unload goods. Import clearance and duties. Bear risk after goods arrive at destination.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are placed at the disposal of the buyer at the named place of destination, ready for unloading.
cost_transfer_point: Seller bears all costs to named destination (excluding import duties and unloading).
insurance: No obligation on either party, but seller bears risk to destination.
key_notes: Seller delivers to destination but does NOT unload and does NOT clear for import.

seller_obligations: Deliver goods UNLOADED at named destination. Arrange all transport and unloading. Clear for export.
buyer_obligations: Import clearance and duties. Bear risk after goods are unloaded.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer once goods are unloaded at the named place of destination.
cost_transfer_point: Seller bears all costs including unloading at destination (excluding import duties).
key_notes: 2020 CHANGE: Renamed from DAT (Delivered at Terminal). Now clarifies that delivery can be at ANY place, not just a terminal. Only Incoterm requiring seller to unload.

seller_obligations: Deliver goods to destination, cleared for import, duties paid. Maximum obligation for seller.
buyer_obligations: Unload goods at destination. Minimum obligation for buyer.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are placed at the disposal of the buyer at the named destination, cleared for import.
cost_transfer_point: Seller bears ALL costs including import duties, taxes, and customs clearance.
insurance: No obligation on either party, but seller bears all risk.
import_clearance: Seller (seller pays all duties and taxes).
key_notes: Maximum obligation for seller. Seller must have import clearance capability in destination country. Opposite of EXW.

mode: Sea and inland waterway transport ONLY
seller_obligations: Deliver goods alongside the vessel at the named port of shipment. Clear goods for export.
buyer_obligations: Arrange and pay for loading onto vessel, main carriage, insurance, import clearance, and all costs from alongside ship.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are placed alongside the vessel at the named port of shipment.
cost_transfer_point: Costs transfer at the point goods are alongside the ship.
key_notes: Maritime only. Goods placed on quay or barge alongside vessel. Not suitable for containerized cargo (use FCA instead).

mode: Sea and inland waterway transport ONLY
seller_obligations: Deliver goods ON BOARD the vessel at the named port of shipment. Clear goods for export.
buyer_obligations: Arrange and pay for main carriage from port of shipment, insurance, import clearance.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are placed on board the vessel at the named port of shipment.
cost_transfer_point: Costs transfer once goods are on board at port of shipment.
key_notes: One of the most commonly used terms. Maritime only. Not for containerized cargo — use FCA instead. Risk passes at ship's rail.

mode: Sea and inland waterway transport ONLY
seller_obligations: Deliver goods on board vessel. Arrange and pay freight to destination port. Clear goods for export.
buyer_obligations: Bear risk from when goods are on board at origin. Import clearance. Unloading at destination.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are placed on board the vessel at the PORT OF SHIPMENT — NOT the destination port.
cost_transfer_point: Seller pays freight to destination port, but risk already transferred at origin port.
key_notes: CRITICAL: Risk transfers at ORIGIN port when loaded on board, even though seller pays freight to DESTINATION. Same split as CPT but for maritime.

mode: Sea and inland waterway transport ONLY
seller_obligations: Deliver goods on board vessel. Arrange and pay freight AND insurance to destination port. Clear goods for export.
buyer_obligations: Bear risk from when goods are on board at origin. Import clearance. Unloading at destination.
risk_transfer_point: Risk transfers to buyer when goods are placed on board the vessel at the PORT OF SHIPMENT — NOT the destination port.
cost_transfer_point: Seller pays freight and insurance to destination port, but risk transfers at origin.
insurance: Seller must obtain MINIMUM coverage — Institute Cargo Clauses (C). This is LOWER than CIP which requires Clause (A).
key_notes: 2020 KEY DISTINCTION: CIF insurance = Clause (C) minimum. CIP insurance = Clause (A) all-risk. Risk transfers at ORIGIN port, not destination.
